events.title: CATHODE Prerelease Update Three
events.summary: Hi all!The last of the changes for CATHODE ahead of the Steam Next Fest are ready!Some of the changes are noted below!Added the Canine, Wolverine, and Cyclone turretsAdded a tech tree for Direct Control modeUpdated tech tree for certain support powersAdded research flavor text and indicators for locked construction optionsAdded new voice lines, including ammo and heat call-outsAdded volume control for these voice linesAdded sound effects for startup, interface text, and results countersPressing

events.title: CATHODE Prerelease Update Two
events.summary: Hi all!Since getting CATHODE up on Steam on the store, I've been working on getting the development build ready ahead of the upcoming Steam Next Fest!Some of the changes are noted below!New enemies and wavesAdded enemy wavesAdded tanks and small dronesAdded high-value targetsUpgrades and resourcesAdded upgrade trees for gun turrets and chain cannonsAdded support and logistics upgrade treesAdded resource-generating uplinksUplink efficiency now depends on placement and terrain heightSupport powers

events.title: CATHODE - Store Page Now Live on Steam!
